groups.name: Aatmoday Cultural & Dance Society
groups.description: The heart of classical dance, folk performances, stage hosting, and festival celebrations at Aatmoday. We organize major campus cultural nights, choreograph group dance pieces, and train hosts for stage events.
groups.target_audience: Dancers, stage hosts, and cultural event enthusiasts of all levels

groups.name: Aatmoday Robotics
groups.description: Building autonomous bots, drone systems, microcontrollers (Arduino/ESP32), and ROS-based software. We compete in national Robocon and hardware hackathons.
groups.target_audience: Coders, hardware geeks, and tech tinkers

groups.name: Nukkad Natak
groups.description: Street plays, social awareness performances, high-energy chants, and theatrical storytelling. We take social messages to campus courtyards and city squares.
groups.target_audience: Passionate actors, voice artists, and performers

groups.name: Trekking Community
groups.description: Weekend hikes, Pavagadh climbs, night treks, camping, and outdoor exploration. Designed for introverted nature lovers and adventure seekers alike.
groups.meeting_time: Meets every Thursday 8:00 PM for weekend planning
groups.target_audience: Hikers, nature enthusiasts, and outdoor lovers

groups.name: Unplugged (Music Club)
groups.description: Acoustic guitar sessions, vocal harmonies, gentle jams under campus lights, and open-mic evenings. Perfect for introverted musicians and passionate singers.
groups.target_audience: Guitarists, singers, and acoustic music enthusiasts

groups.name: Aatmoday Developers Club (ADC)
groups.description: Full-stack development, competitive coding, machine learning, and hackathon sprints. Beginner mentorship tracks in Python, Web Dev, and AI.
groups.target_audience: Coders and software builders of all years

groups.name: Kartavya Voluntourism & Impact Drive
groups.description: Weekend teaching drives, community service, eco-tourism volunteering, and food relief. Combining travel with social responsibility.
groups.target_audience: Students looking to make a positive social impact

groups.name: Midnight Football League
groups.description: Late-night turf football under floodlights. 5v5 and 7v7 casual and tournament matches every week.

groups.name: FragZone Esports & Gaming Guild
groups.description: Competitive FIFA, Valorant, BGMI, and CS2 gaming squad. Scrims, LAN tournaments, and gaming watchparties.

events.name: Annual Cultural Gala & Dance Showcase
events.description: Grand campus evening featuring classical dance recitals, folk ensembles, and live stage hosting competitions.

events.name: RoboWars & Embedded Hackathon
events.description: 24-hour hardware and robotics hackathon. Build autonomous maze-solving bots and smart IoT devices.

events.name: Street Play Championship (Nukkad Spardha)
events.description: Inter-college street play competition showcasing powerful social narratives through rhythm, chants, and acting.

events.name: Acoustic Unplugged Evening
events.description: Under-the-stars acoustic session featuring solo singers, acoustic guitar solos, and soft jamming.
events.target_audience: Music lovers, gentle singers, acoustic guitarists

events.name: Pavagadh Sunrise Trek
events.description: Early morning weekend hike up Pavagadh Hill with breakfast at the summit.
